byte_matched.note: re-encoding from the model reproduces every byte of the vendor container; the recompress pass differs only in the LZSS tie-break order, so it is reported in `unresolved`, not here.

formally_verified.note: bit-vector proofs over the pure model: Mangle round and 48-round chain, CRC-32 register and word step, Borland LCG period, MS-DOS date packing, LZSS token and window-slot layout, 8-byte alignment.

tested.note: every function case compares the returned word and all byte-level memory effects of the native run with the Python transcription; the stack slots the ABI owns are excluded on both sides.

preserved_unchanged.note: the mixed C + assembly listing keeps the original bytes of data, string and jump-table regions at their original addresses; nothing in that region is rewritten.
